name: Miven Machine Tools Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Miven Machine Tools Ltd manufactures and sells CNC Machines and other related parts
keyPoints:
Company Overview:[1]
Company started as a joint venture between Mysore Kirloskar Ltd and Warner & Swasey USA. Later it was brought by Giddings & Lewis Inc, USA which was then acquired by NASPL. Presently, NASPL has majority of shareholding 
of company (75%)

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
